name: Orderful
description: One API that speaks each retailer's document format, plus a browser form so a small brand can send Walmart or Kohl's the required notices without an EDI specialist. San Francisco.

mentions.evidence: A design case study says annual revenue reached more than $10 million a year by 2025, up from under $1 million in 2021. That is a third party's claim, not the company's figure. On 23 June 2026 they raised a $35 million Series C, bringing the total raised to $85 million, and that money is funding, not revenue. They say they have processed more than 6 billion documents in 9 years. That count is volume, not revenue.
mentions.indieAngle: The form for the supplier who has days to comply is the piece to copy.

whyItPrints: Same retailer rule as SPS Commerce, sold to developers and to the small vendor who just got the order.
whyThisMatters: Same retailer rule as SPS Commerce, sold as an API and as a browser form. Orderful lets a small brand send Walmart or Kohl's the required notices without an EDI specialist. San Francisco. A design case study says annual revenue reached more than 10 million dollars a year by 2025, up from under 1 million dollars in 2021. That is a former employee's case study, not a company figure, so it stays labeled as a claim. On 23 June 2026 they raised a 35 million dollar Series C, bringing the total raised to 85 million dollars. That money is funding, not revenue. Their own count is more than 6 billion documents across 9 years. That count is volume, not sales. The figure is self-reported, which means a third party wrote the yearly line. I did not open the books.
